text: Men adda e kala mofte, Annabaajo maɓɓe on, ko seeditoo e kuuɗe maɓɓe, immorde e yeddugol fenna, Men wi'ana fennuɓe ɓen e maɓɓe: Addee hujjaaji mon ɗin e ko yeddirayoɗon fennon kon. Ɗin hujjaaji majjitora ɓe, ɓe fellita wonnde goonga ka sikke alaa e mu'un kan, ko Alla woodani; ko ɓe fefindotonoo kon e kafidaaɗi Alla, fow majjitora ɓe.
